## What problem does this solve?

Link an issue or describe the user/scientific need.

## What changed?

Include interface, schema, provenance, or approval changes. Explain anything deliberately out of scope.

## How was it tested?

Commands run and results; use offline tests and synthetic data. Disclose checks not run.

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior or this is documentation-only.
- [ ] Examples and docs match the implementation.
- [ ] No secrets, `.bio/` data, identifying information, or proprietary fixtures are included.
- [ ] Simulated, operator-attested, and provider-verified evidence are not conflated.
- [ ] Approval and result integrity are preserved.
- [ ] I have permission to submit this work under Apache 2.0.

## Review notes

Mention scientific assumptions, migration needs, third-party material, and material AI assistance that reviewers should understand.
